Beginner
5B  Speaking
Description
Students plan a speaking exercise about a special day in their lives to practise past simple: have, go, get
Lesson link
Use this activity after exercise 5e, page 47
Time
20 minutes
Extra material None
Instructions
a Point out that for two of the blog writers 18th
October 2006 was an ordinary day. Ask SS ‘Which
writer wrote about a special day?’ Elicit writer
1 (Pauline) as it was her wedding anniversary.
Ask SS if they know of any other special days in
a person’s history. Elicit birthday (SS may also
suggest wedding day, graduation, engagement,
name day, starting school / university, etc. It’s OK
for them to do this in their L1 if they need to).
b Write on the board:
A special day in my history
Who you were with
Where you were
What you did
Why it was special
c Tell SS to plan to speak to a partner about a
special day in their history (it can be a special
event like a wedding or just a day that they really
enjoyed). Suggest that they write brief notes
based on the phrases on the board to structure
their story logically. They can also refer to the
language in the blogs in exercise 5. Set a time
limit of five minutes for SS to plan.
d SS take turns to talk about their special day.
When SS have finished, ask individuals to report
about their partner’s special day. Write any useful
vocabulary and phrases on the board for SS to
copy.
